description: This file declares the COMRPCStarter class, which implements the IPluginStarter interface to connect to Thunder over COM-RPC and start plugins. It includes class declaration, constructor, destructor, and a method to activate plugins, along with private members for connection and plugin name.

classes.name: COMRPCStarter
classes.description: A class implementing IPluginStarter to manage plugin startup via COM-RPC, connecting to Thunder and controlling plugin activation.

methods.name: COMRPCStarter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the COMRPCStarter with a plugin name.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Attempts to activate a plugin with specified retries and delay.
